description: Edit a message the bot itself sent, or one posted through one of the server's webhooks (that needs Manage Webhooks). Discord does not allow editing anyone else's messages, no matter the permission level. A message sent as a Components V2 layout stays one: edit it with components, never with content or embeds.

components.description: Rich layout, in place of content and embeds. Sending this sets the Components V2 flag, which is permanent for that message: it can never show plain content or embeds afterward, so the two cannot be combined.

accent_color.description: For container, hex color of the left edge, like #5865f2.

buttons.description: For buttons, 1-5 link buttons on one row. For section, exactly one. Link buttons only: this server does not answer interactions, so a button that fires one would fail for whoever clicked it.

components.description: For container, the 1-10 blocks inside it.

url.description: Public image URL, or attachment://<filename> for a file sent with the message.

type.description: Same block types as above, except container.

divider.description: For separator, draw a horizontal rule. Default true.

media.description: For gallery, 1-10 images. For section, exactly one, shown as a thumbnail on the right.

url.description: Public image URL, or attachment://<filename> for a file sent with the message.

spacing.description: For separator, how much padding. Default small.

spoiler.description: For container, blur the whole group until clicked.

text.description: Markdown body. Required for text and section.

type.description: text: a paragraph of markdown. section: text with a thumbnail or link button beside it. gallery: 1-10 images. separator: vertical space, optionally a rule. buttons: a row of link buttons. container: a bordered group with a colored edge.

content.description: The new text, replacing the message's current text.

embeds.description: Up to 10 embeds. Each needs a title, a description, an author, fields, a footer, or a picture. Discord allows 6,000 characters of text across all of one message's embeds.

author.description: Small line above the title, such as who it is from.

fields.description: Up to 25 name and value pairs under the description.

inline.description: Sits beside its neighbours instead of on a row of its own.

image_url.description: Large picture under the text: an http or https link, or attachment://<filename> for a file that comes with the message.

thumbnail_url.description: Small picture in the top corner, given the same way.

timestamp.description: A time shown beside the footer: "now" for the current time, or ISO 8601, like 2026-11-09T18:00:00Z. With no zone it is read as UTC.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

message_id.description: Message ID, or the message's link.

name: edit_message
title: Edit message
